order: Close the remaining live-checkout sweep hazard. When the alias a live checkout was created through is later removed, sweep-time re-resolution falls back to the lexical alias spelling while the listed path stays canonical, and the sweep deletes a live checkout. Capture each entry's canonical directory at creation, when every component is guaranteed resolvable, and have the live set compare that captured identity — never a sweep-time re-resolution. Pin the alias-removal probe as a standing regression check. Separately, diagnose and guard the review-lane reclamation flake, which is test-only: a newly created worktree is held locked for the whole checkout while its entry is already list-visible, and one forced remove cannot remove a locked worktree, so the termination branch must wait out the registration window exactly as the kill branch already does. Record the round's review verdict verbatim, and keep the tranche under revision.
claims: Canonical identity is captured at creation and compared by the live set; no sweep-time re-resolution remains on that path, and the alias-removal probe is pinned as a regression. The termination branch now waits out the registration window; three baseline and two post-fix runs of the review-lane suite came back 114 of 114. Suites are green — verifier 98, router 135, registry 31 — with the full integration-equivalent pass and the pull request's nine checks all passing.
